{"consolidated_memory":"LATENCY SPIKE INVESTIGATIONS IN ml/serving/batcher.py (ml pipeline side) – 4 separate occasions, all with identical signal (tail far above median in serving histogram) but distinct root causes and fixes

Common details across all occasions:
- File: ml/serving/batcher.py
- Reproduction method: send the mixed-size request trace
- Signal: tail far above median in serving histogram
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/ml/test_batcher.py

OCCASION 1 [2026-01-09]:
- Trigger: latency spike only for clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #2697 on branch fix/latency-spike-1
- Result: job finished in 45 minutes instead of 3 hours

OCCASION 2 [2026-01-19]:
- Trigger: latency spike only for payloads above roughly 2 megabytes
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #5607 on branch fix/latency-spike-2
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 25 days running

OCCASION 3 [2026-03-04]:
- Trigger: latency spike only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against aware one (timezone mismatch)
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #5767 on branch fix/latency-spike-3
- Result: 94 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

OCCASION 4 [2026-06-12]:
- Trigger: latency spike only on the first request after a cold start
- Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #8512 on branch fix/latency-spike-4
- Result: reclaimed 83 GB of blob storage"}
